Class GameController

java.lang.Object
com.comp2042.core.GameController
All Implemented Interfaces:
InputEventListener
public class GameController extends Object implements InputEventListener
Controller class that manages the game logic and acts as an intermediary between the game board model and the GUI controller. Can be considered the "Controller" in the MVC pattern. Implements InputEventListener to handle all player input events including movement, rotation, and drops.

    • onDownEvent

      public DownData onDownEvent(MoveEvent event)
      Handles a soft drop (down) event. Moves the piece down and handles locking, line clearing, and game over detection when the piece cannot move further.
      Specified by:
      onDownEvent in interface InputEventListener
      Parameters:
      event - the move event containing type and source information
      Returns:
      DownData containing the result of the move and any cleared rows

    • onHardDropEvent

      public DownData onHardDropEvent(MoveEvent event)
      Handles a hard drop event. Instantly drops the piece to the bottom, awards points, and processes line clears.
      Specified by:

      Parameters:

    • onRotateEvent

      public ViewData onRotateEvent(MoveEvent event)
      Handles a rotation event. Rotates the current piece 90 degrees counter-clockwise. If the rotation is blocked, it may attempt a wall kick.
      Specified by:
      onRotateEvent in interface InputEventListener
      Parameters:
      event - the move event
      Returns:
      ViewData representing the updated game state including the new rotation

    • createNewGame

      public void createNewGame()
      Creates a new game instance. Can be called to start the first game or restart an existing one. Initializes the Board model, binds UI properties like score, and triggers the initial view refresh.
